descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S15 「没有副本留下：37 h 清除后，在每个字段和每张表里搜调老的值」 No copy survives: after the 37 h purge, search every field and table for the aged values

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden …（UAT OAT-04；UAT OAT-04 step 2；TFA-94699 AC 1；TFA-92568 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U16 The Hospital course timeline keeps only today's and yesterday's lines (server days); older lines are deleted from the chart, not only hidden.（UAT 3.6 (course timeline and prior transcripts show today and yesterday only)；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)；TFA-94699 snapshot (TFA-92589 / PR #91 hands the purge of older lines to this ticket)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient seeded with a unique marker in every place patient data can sit: vitals and labs and their dated histories, medication rows and medication events, the note, its billing suggestion and addendum, the carry-forward line, the encounter transcript, a course timeline line dated three days ago, a handoff tha …

When The purge runs; the patient's document, its patient-list row, handoffs, quickDictationDrafts and unassignedRoundingItems are dumped with admin access and searched for the markers

Then No marker of an item past its window is found anywhere; markers in items whose window is undecided (Q6, Q10) are listed separately

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-04 Expected 2 ('live patient data never survives past its window') and the 3.7 retention claim: a marker found for an item whose window has passed = Fail (RET-COURSE-912 per U16); RET-TX-909 / RET-NOTE-905 at 37 h are judged per Q4; roster, background and the other Q6 / Q10 items are reported as 'needs a decision', not judged

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92568 in progress；TFA-92589 ready for qa；TFA-94699 in progress

所有内容记下 37 小时后，旧的体征和化验还在按日期排的表格里，交接全文还能看，3 天前的病程行也还存着。

37 h after everything was recorded the patient's old vitals and labs are still in the dated grids, the full handoff text is still readable, and a course line from 3 days ago is still stored.

依据：allure 9c445faf-…-result.json; retention lane, marker search over the admin dump. 1 check passes, 4 fail, all known: K6 (vitalsHistory/labsHistory, admissionSummary.course) and K3 (handoffs). Recorded against Q4/Q6/Q10: the transcript (per-stay policy), medicationEvents, billingSuggestion, addendum, nextPreRoundSummary and Quick Dictation compartments still hold the marker.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

怎么测（retention/plan.json，automatable: yes）：API spec: one chart with a unique marker in every place (vitals + vitalsHistory, labs + labsHistory, med row, medicationEvents, note, billing, addendum, carry-forward, encounter + transcript, course line 3 days old, handoff text, Quick Dictation compartment assigned through quickDictation:assign); every clock aged 37 h by the helper; purge; marker search over the admin dump of all tables. Q4/Q6/Q10 markers recorded. The helper's days option now also moves transcriptDate (whole calendar days in the browser's zone; exact for this single 37 h move of a today stamp), and the vitalsHistory / labsHistory dates the same way. — Raw admin dump covers every table that holds patient text.
